patch.after: Lists issues, optionally filtered by status and/or assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues by those fields; use search_issues to match text in title or body, and get_issue for one known ID. Returns at most limit issues (default 50), with comments included by default. Cannot search text.

Searches issues by case-insensitive substring match on title or body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one known ID. Cannot filter by status or assignee and has no limit; comments are included by default.
Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Any other value returns an error. Omit to include all statuses.
Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true when omitted; set false for a smaller, summary-only response.
